articles.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Q1 2026 Earnings Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: ServiceNow (NOW) Q1 2026 Earnings Transcript. Darren Yip: Good afternoon, and thank you for joining ServiceNow's First Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call. Joining me are Bill McDermott, our Chairman and Chief Executive Officer; Gina Mastantuono, our President and Chief Financial Officer; and Amit Zavery, President, Chief Product Officer and Chief Operating Officer. Related tickers mentioned: NOW.

articles.title: Zeta (ZETA) Q4 2025 Earnings Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: Zeta (ZETA) Q4 2025 Earnings Transcript. None of our guidance raise is related to political candidate revenue, which we continue to assume will be $15 million in 2026 with $7 million in the third quarter and $8 million in the fourth quarter. Additionally, we continue to take a conservative view of Marigold, contributing at least $190 million in 2026 revenue. And lastly, our revenue guidance includes minimal contribution from Athena-driven revenue with its broad-based adoption representing incremental consumption revenue upside.

articles.title: Thryv (THRY) Q4 2024 Earnings Call Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: Thryv (THRY) Q4 2024 Earnings Call Transcript. This quarter marks our first time reporting SaaS results inclusive of Keap software following our acquisition on October 31, 2024. With only two months of Keap's revenue reflected, we are focused on executing our integration plan and realizing the synergies we outlined at Analyst Day. To note, for 2025, total SaaS revenue will reflect the combined performance of Thryv and Keap. Related tickers mentioned: THRY.
